description: Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) protocol: 4 manual gates + 2 automatic gates. Names aligned with skills/kernel.md (Fix-1: PLANNING_GATE/MERGE_GATE retired).
hitl_reduction_strategy: Agen HANYA meminta persetujuan pada gerbang manual. Di luar itu, agen berstatus FULLY AUTONOMOUS, diizinkan gagal, merevisi kodenya sendiri, dan mengulang loop internal hingga lolos kompilasi dan audit.

START_APPROVAL.description: THINK: persetujuan Goal Stack, Scope arsitektur & Flow Plan awal (wajib bila berdampak masif).

CCC_AUTHORIZATION_GATE.description: Pra-SYNC/Pra-ACT: verifikasi system_health cortex dan pemilihan task prioritas tertinggi.

STRICT_VALIDATION.description: ACT: kode lolos hanya jika Test dan Post-Execution Evals PASS.

MERGE_APPROVAL.description: REFLECT: persetujuan final merge + verifikasi blok disclosure keputusan otonom.

DESTRUCTIVE_GATE.description: Kapan pun: konfirmasi sebelum DROP/DELETE database atau hapus file krusial.

ESCALATION_GATE.description: Intervensi darurat saat Circuit Breaker aktif atau infinite loop terdeteksi.

VIBE.authority: orchestrator auto for trivial signals; user may force

FACTORY.authority: default; START_APPROVAL wajib bila berdampak masif; user may force

CRITICAL.authority: auto when critical signals match; security auditor mandatory; explicit HITL

lane_rules: Classify lane at THINK start and record it (cortex task, FPLAN header, telemetry).
CRITICAL signals always win over other classifications.
Escalation VIBE->FACTORY->CRITICAL allowed anytime; no automatic de-escalation.
speed_mode must not bypass lane mapping.
